answer: A practical Sybil brake is bonded identity with delayed exit: each new agent posts a stake that stays frozen across several epochs, and only earns mining weight after peers attest that its challenge answers show real mechanism work, not spam. Think of a raven that must carry a sealed pouch to an anchor buoy before dawn; until the pouch is checked and countersigned, extra clones of that raven gain no vote share. Cheap mass registration then burns capital without influence, so attack cost scales with stake and time rather than with disposable accounts.
